thread:
alex: Hey team — getting 401 invalid_api_key on embeddings/encode from our backend after rotating keys. Worked earlier today, then started failing after we updated env var. Error: {\"error\":{\"message\":\"Invalid API key\",\"type\":\"invalid_request_error\"}}

maya: Sorry to hear that, can you paste the exact header you send (redact key but keep surrounding characters)? Also which SDK or curl are you using?

alex: We're using a small node service and tested with curl. Here's the snippet from our deploy env (redacted):

```
API_KEY=\"`sk-prod_abc123...xyz`\"
export API_KEY
node server.js
```

When I curl directly I did: `curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer \`$API_KEY\`\" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings` and I get the 401.

liam: Ah — looks like the key string in your env has literal backticks in it (`` ` ``). The code sample shows the key wrapped in backticks. That will change the header value.

maya: Can you try without backticks and without the surrounding quotes? Example:

Incorrect header (what you're sending):
```
Authorization: Bearer `sk-prod_abc123...xyz`
```
Correct header: (no backticks, raw key)
```
Authorization: Bearer sk-prod_abc123...xyz
```
alex: OK testing now... reproducer below. I removed backticks from the env value and did: `curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY\" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -d '{\"input\":\"hello\"}'`

deploy-bot: deploy 1746004400 completed to staging :white_check_mark:

alex: With backticks removed the call succeeds. Thanks. Any idea why I had backticks in the env? We copied the key from a markdown doc where the key was inline code. I pasted the whole thing into a .env and didn't strip the backticks.

liam: Common copy/paste issue. SDKs tolerate extra whitespace sometimes but not characters like backticks. Two recommendations: 1) strip surrounding backticks/quotes when copying into env files; 2) when possible, load secrets via your CI/CD secret manager rather than pasting into .env. We'll add a short note in the troubleshooting docs.

maya: I'll mark this as resolved and follow up with the customer asking if they'd like us to validate keys in the UI (help avoid copying with backticks). :thumbsup:

alex: Thanks all! :pray:
